ownership.quote: 2021 A new startup is born. ... 2022 We raise a pre-seed round with top-tier backers.

stage.quote: we're also super proud to announce our latest $6M seed raise with Heavybit as lead investor, with the participation of Vercel Ventures, Mango Capital, Firestreak Ventures, Fly VC and First Momentum Ventures, along with a host of world class angels.
stage.note: This Oct 2025 $6M seed round is the last priced round found; it follows an earlier 2022 pre-seed round (amount undisclosed) per Unikraft's own 'our journey' timeline.

total_funding_usd.basis: Only the $6M Oct-2025 seed round has a disclosed amount (company blog). An earlier 2022 pre-seed round is confirmed to have happened (unikraft.com/about) but its amount was never disclosed, so true cumulative total is likely somewhat higher than $6M; a third-party aggregator (Startup Intros) estimates $12.0M across 2 rounds but this is unverified.
total_funding_usd.quote: we're also super proud to announce our latest $6M seed raise with Heavybit as lead investor

last_round.quote: Today, and after years of hard work, we're ecstatic to announce the launch of Unikraft Cloud ... In support of this, we're also super proud to announce our latest $6M seed raise with Heavybit as lead investor, with the participation of Vercel Ventures, Mango Capital, Firestreak Ventures, Fly VC and First Momentum Ventures, along with a host of world class angels.

note: Unikraft Inc. (brand 'Unikraft Cloud', product formerly launched as 'KraftCloud' via HN Launch HN on 2024-04-02) is a separate commercial company from the open-source Unikraft unikernel project (unikraft.org), which began as NEC Labs Europe research (2017) and became a Linux Foundation/Xen Project hosted project in 2019. Unikraft Inc. was founded 2021/2022 by the same core team (Felipe Huici CEO, Simon Kuenzer CTO, Alexander Jung CPO) to commercialize a cloud platform built on that research; it is not itself a Linux Foundation entity. No evidence of a YC or other accelerator batch was found (a YC directory search for 'unikraft' returns no matching company).
